derivation.languageGateway: 2 calls per completed user/assistant turn: one EN-to-FR input projection and one FR-to-EN output projection
derivation.scientificConversation: 1 Gemini natural-conversation call per routed scientific turn
derivation.persistentExtraction: 0 when ineligible; for the frozen construction scenarios, 1 normal OpenAI extraction call and at most 1 automatic recovery call after a recoverable deterministic validation failure

expectedLanguageGatewayCalls.normalMinimumBasis: 4 scenarios multiplied by one initial completed turn multiplied by 2 projections
expectedLanguageGatewayCalls.maximumBasis: 4 scenarios multiplied by 8 turns multiplied by 2 projections

expectedScientificProviderCalls.normalMinimumBasis: one routed natural-conversation call for each initial frozen construction request
expectedScientificProviderCalls.maximumBasis: one natural-conversation call per allowed turn

expectedExtractionCalls.normalMinimumBasis: one extraction attempt for each initial construction-eligible scenario
expectedExtractionCalls.maximumBasis: two attempts per eligible turn across all scenarios
